rounds.summary: Round 1: full Circle & Line style. Its app renders (app/renders/r1/) were deleted before the owner saw them; round 2 renders in app/renders/r2/ supersede them.
changes: Controls (buttons, fields, select, segmented, tabs, chips, switch) are outlined round pills with a 1.5px ink line; the main action is a solid primary pill with the same line.
Cards, callouts, toasts and overlays are flat paper planes with a 1px hairline and a 20px radius, no shadow.
Headline is Jost 500, tight, with a butter band along the foot of the highlight word; section labels are tracked small caps.
Canvas colour pull set to 0 so dark stays at the brand #101116 instead of a lifted blue-grey.
Switch drawn as an outlined pill so the off track is visible in both modes.

variants.change: switch material: slug-switch (square, no off track) and knob-switch (shaded knob, no off track) killed for outlined pill
highlight: full butter block (white text on butter in dark) killed for a thick underline band
card and callout material: hairline-box (square) killed for outlined 1px line role (radius 20)

notes.text: Selected sidebar item is the shell's pale tint with a left primary bar, not a solid periwinkle pill: the Mac sidebar is not reachable by catalog moves.
Selected list row is a squared tint wash with no radius 14 and no periwinkle circle: no catalog move draws either.
Off switch shows the outlined track but no visible knob (see n7 in round 2).
Replay audio and Export everything sit under the fold veil in the Mac window, so they render faded; the roomy 20px cards push the main action down.
Chart line and area use periwinkle in dark and ink in light; chart colour is a shell default.
Solid ink circle holding the icon at the end of the main action pill is not expressible; the shell's arrow glyph stays.

rounds.summary: Round 2: fix pass from the coordinator's read. App renders are in app/renders/r2/; checker shots in shots/r2/.
changes: Selected and unselected segment, tab and chip labels now share the same tracking (pair-selected tracking 0); selection shows through the periwinkle fill and weight 600.
Section labels are Inter caps at weight 600 with 0.08em tracking; the mono label move was removed.
The product sheet now puts Replay audio right under the history list, so the main action sits above the fold.

Switch is now flat-fill muted (outlined only accepts transparent or canvas fill, so it cannot take muted): the off track is a solid grey that holds 3:1 against the canvas with a canvas-coloured knob in light and an ink knob in dark; on stays a periwinkle track.

variants.change: switch material: knob-switch (gradient and shadow), slug-switch and legend-switch (square), ink-mark (broken crescent) and outlined (invisible off knob) all killed; flat-fill muted kept

notes.text: Off switch had no visible knob (canvas knob on a canvas-filled outlined track). Fixed by switching to flat-fill with fill muted; the switch no longer carries the 1.5px ink line.
Cards keep about 50px above the title: the shell sets the card title margin with !important and no catalog param reaches it.

rounds.summary: Owner's notes on round 2 were taken past this renderer into HTML mock-ups of the real Youch! window (TTS+ design/directions/ui4/a-circle-line/). The owner picked this style there and Youch! locked it as look/circle-line (D-037).
changes: Owner's notes on round 2: more modern, slightly more character, no colour highlighting (the butter band behind titles is gone), in HTML.
The HTML version uses Outfit 600 for the heading in place of Jost; look.json heading changed to match.

In HTML only (no catalog move reaches these): the selected nav pill, the list inside one hairline card with a radius-14 selected wash, circle app tiles, the main action ending in a solid ink circle, card padding 22-24, and the Insights thread chart as a flat area graph.
Butter is at most one small solid circle per screen, never behind text.

variants.change: type: Outfit 600 headings in place of Jost

notes.text: The renderer cannot style the Mac sidebar, wrap a list in a card, round the selected row, end a button in a circle, or tighten card padding, so the HTML mock in TTS+ design/directions/ui4/a-circle-line/ is the visual reference wherever it and this style differ.
